Major Disruption.description: Significant Iranian production offline + partial Hormuz restriction

trade_recommendations.name: Naked 140 Call (Pure Tail Risk)
trade_recommendations.reasoning: HIGHEST EV trade. Extremely cheap lottery ticket on geopolitical tail. 75% prob of profit with 45% Super Spike + 30% Major Disruption scenarios. Catastrophic upside if Hormuz closes. Max loss only $0.22 per contract. This is the single best risk/reward in the chain.
trade_recommendations.execution_notes: Use limit orders on COIL. Excellent liquidity. Consider scaling into 2-5 lots per $100k portfolio.

trade_recommendations.name: 2x 120C / 3x 160C Ratio Spread
trade_recommendations.reasoning: Leveraged exposure to both disruption scenarios. Peaks at $160 (Major Disruption midpoint). 2:3 ratio provides delta enhancement while capping upside risk at extreme Super Spike levels (215+). Better than straight spread for volatility harvesting. EV=$31.27 on $0.98 cost.
trade_recommendations.execution_notes: Execute as single spread order. Monitor gamma risk above 160. Consider rolling short strikes higher if Brent approaches 145.

trade_recommendations.name: 120/150 Call Spread (Balanced Disruption)
trade_recommendations.reasoning: Best defined-risk trade. Captures both Major Disruption (155) and Super Spike (215) scenarios. Strikes align with key disruption thresholds. 60:1 payoff ratio is exceptional. Max profit achieved at 150, which is conservative for both upside scenarios.
trade_recommendations.execution_notes: Most liquid spread. Use native spread order on ICE. Can scale to larger size. Consider laddering entries if IV drops.

trade_recommendations.name: 130/160 Call Spread (Super Spike Focus)
trade_recommendations.reasoning: ULTRA-CHEAP Super Spike play. 119:1 payoff ratio is absurd for 75% win probability. Slightly OTM but still captures Major Disruption partially. Best bang-for-buck if you believe in high-conviction tail scenario. Max profit at 160 covers middle of Major Disruption range.
trade_recommendations.execution_notes: Extremely tight bid-ask. Use limit orders. Scale into position. Consider 2-3x normal size given low absolute cost.

trade_recommendations.name: 150/180 Call Spread (Pure Super Spike)
trade_recommendations.reasoning: HIGHEST payoff ratio at 315:1. Concentrated bet on Super Spike scenario only. Effectively a binary bet on Hormuz closure. Cheap enough ($0.10) to justify as pure speculation. Lower EV than others but incredible asymmetry. Only makes money if Brent >150.
trade_recommendations.execution_notes: Illiquid strikes. Work orders patiently. Size appropriately small. This is a moonshot - only for high conviction Super Spike believers.

portfolio_allocation_example.notes: Conservative sizing at ~15% of capital deployed. All trades have positive EV. Portfolio wins big in Super Spike (45% prob) and Major Disruption (30% prob) scenarios. Max loss is only $15k with upside potential >$100k.

priority_order: Trade 2 (Ratio) - More complex, get good fill
execution_strategy.timing: Enter over 2-3 days to avoid moving market. Use limit orders 1-2 ticks below mid.
execution_strategy.risk_management: Set mental stops if Brent breaks below 85. Consider taking profits at 50-100% gain on spreads if scenarios materialize early.
